title: [bug] Register deep-link with single instance not working.
body:
### Describe the bug

I am using create tauri app to test deep link, I am expect to have a feature that open tauri-test://* url and read the content with the running app, and the app could log the content from the console. 
But the system doesn't recognize the link 

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/baee4bb5-7fcd-4019-99bf-97ea3ba6448e)

I use   useEffect(() => {
    onOpenUrl((urls) => {
      setGreetMsg(urls[0]);
    });

    isRegistered("tauri-test").then((registered) => {
      console.log(registered);
      if (!registered) {
        setGreetMsg("Not registered");
      }
    });
  }, []);

to see if the link has been registered but encountering 
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/66d1d69e-67e2-4505-94b3-f4e565c4422d)


### Reproduction

https://github.com/reporter/tauri-feature-test
I have upload this repo to reproduce this bug.

### Expected behavior

Could open tauri-test://* URL and can see url logged at console

comments.author: reporter
participant1
comments.body:
> It seems like the link triggers another instance, and the single instance plugin closed it immediately.

Yep, which is what it's supposed to do

> I think I could use app.emit here and listen to this event at js side as a work around. But is this the expect result?

This is what the `"deep-link"` feature flag in cargo.toml does already. Also it looks like you did something different than what i wanted you to try so here's another description:
1) Run `tauri dev`
2) new terminal, cd into target/debug/
3) `./tauri-test.exe` or `./tauri-test.exe "tauri-test://1234"`

This should be the same as the `start` stuff but with a higher chance of seeing an error message
